title: Retain Hand
smart_description: [gold]Retain[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold] (this turn if stack=1, or for the next [blue]{Amount}[/blue] turns if stack>1).
notes: Decrements by 1 at the end of each turn while the power owner's side is active. Only affects the power owner (ShouldFlush returns true if applied to other players).
